name: da-content trigger queries
description: Should trigger when generating or fixing HTML for DA upload (block/section/page metadata structure, icons, images, cell content), calling the DA Source API for uploads, uploading media, or diagnosing silent content failures after preview; near misses are token acquisition (da-auth), local dev server and aem content clone/pull (aem-cli), block JS/CSS, content modeling, page import and testing.

queries.query: I'm building a new 'testimonials' block. Write the HTML for a sample page with three testimonials that I can upload to our DA site and preview.
The pages I generate for Experience Workspace use for icons. Some previewed fine, but after a teammate opened one in the editor the icon was gone. How should icons be written so they survive?
My generated page has a div with class metadata containing title and description rows, but the preview has no <title> or meta description. Why?

I wrote an HTML file for our site with

Welcome

Intro

and uploaded it. After preview the page is empty. What's wrong with the markup?
I added a div with class 'Section Metadata' and a style row to my page in Experience Workspace to get a dark background, but the section renders without it. What am I doing wrong?
My curl PUT to admin.da.live/source/acme/site/page.html returns 200 and a JSON body, but the file isn't there when I open it in da.live. What is going wrong?
I need to upload a hero PNG and an SVG logo to DA from a script so my pages can reference them. How should I do the upload, and does it need previewing?
After previewing my page the images show src="about:error". The HTML uses . How do I fix this?
Previewing a DA page that references my logo.svg fails with a 409 error about the SVG. The file is 55 KB. What is the limit and what can I do?
I put a plain data table in the HTML I author for Experience Workspace, but after preview it becomes a weird block and the header row is gone. How do I avoid that?
I uploaded a page to DA and previewed it. I want to see exactly how the pipeline interpreted my HTML (which tags survived) but the aem.page site needs auth. How can I inspect it?
Inside my block cells I use <span class="price"> and <b> for styling, and after preview the span class is gone and my CSS selectors on <b> don't match. What does the pipeline do to these?
In my DA HTML I used absolute links to our aem.page URLs and they come out as relative paths after preview. Is that expected, and what about target=_blank?
I need an IMS token for a CI job that calls the DA admin API for our org. How do I get one for a service account?
Get the local dev server running for this repo so I can look at the homepage.
Write the JavaScript decorate function for a new accordion block that reads the rows from the authored block and builds details/summary elements.
Import https://example.com/about into our site as an EDS page, matching our existing blocks.
Design the content model for a product-card block: which fields should authors fill in and how should the table be laid out for authoring?
Pull down /products from da.live, change the prices in a few pages, and push the edits back.
My cards block overflows on mobile and the CSS custom properties from styles.css aren't applied. Fix the CSS.
Add unit tests for my countdown block's decorate function and run them.
I want to try my new block locally with a test page. Write the sample page HTML and put it where the dev server will serve it; I don't need to sync anything with our content source.
The sample content I generate for blocks loses its <span> classes and <b> tags after the pipeline runs. Which inline tags are safe inside block cells?
Our Experience Workspace site needs a script that uploads generated pages and images. What are the rules for the page HTML and for uploading images so nothing silently breaks?
Generate a landing page with a hero block, a three-column cards block and page metadata as authored content HTML for our EDS site.
Our EDS site is authored in Word on SharePoint. How do I add a metadata table with title and description to a document?
We use the Universal Editor on AEM Cloud Service. How do I add a new component model for a teaser?
I can't log in to Experience Workspace from my script: the API returns 403 for my account. How do I diagnose it?

I'm writing a static test page by hand for my new block so I can view it locally. What HTML structure must it have so the pipeline and decoration treat it like real authored content (sections, block markup, metadata)?
